description.value: The Cardero branch of BCLIQUOR is one of 198 provincial government liquor retail stores operated by the BC Liquor Distribution Branch, offering wine, spirits, beer, coolers, ciders, and non-alcoholic products. Located on Davie Street in Vancouver's West End, it sits close to popular cycling routes including the Seawall. The store also accepts empty container returns for recycling, which may be useful for cyclists managing pack weight.
